Subject: RFI: Support coverage details and TAM engagement model

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking this RFI. HorizonPay is compiling vendor responses for our payments platform migration and we need a concise package covering support hours, TAM coverage model, escalation paths, and sample incident communications. Specifically we are looking for:

- TAM coverage matrix (roles, SLAs, on-call overlap, regional coverage)
- Escalation ladder (who gets notified at Sev3 / Sev2 / Sev1 and expected response windows)
- Example incident comms (customer-facing timeline and internal playbook)
- Evidence pointers (SOC2, audit logs, runbooks)

Can you send a single consolidated response and any templates we can use for our procurement review? Our deadline to include in the RFP packet is 2026-11-05 COB.

Appreciate it — please include any contacts for contract/SLA discussions.

Best,
Aisha Noor

HorizonPay

Subject: Final: RFI packet — TAM coverage, escalation ladder, incident comms (HorizonPay)

Hi Aisha — please find our consolidated RFI response attached and summarized inline below. Thanks for the time window; we prioritized the items you called out and included templates for HorizonPay to reuse.

Summary (high level):
- TAM coverage model: Dedicated/Private customers receive a named Technical Account Manager (TAM) and a regional coverage plan. Standard TAM hours: 9am-6pm local business time with on-call overlap 24x7 escalation via a named on-call engineer for Sev1 incidents. See attached matrix for role-level mapping and shift overlaps.
- Escalation ladder and SLAs: Acknowledge windows: Sev1 = 15 minutes, Sev2 = 1 hour, Sev3 = 4 hours. Action start windows: Sev1 = 30 minutes, Sev2 = 4 hours. Escalation chain: TAM -> Platform Reliability Lead (Laura Bennett) -> VP Solutions Eng (Ben Carter) -> CRO/CTO for extended Sev1 outages (>4 hours).
- Incident communications: Customer-facing template attached. Initial customer update for Sev1 is within 30 minutes with hourly updates until stable. We include root-cause analysis and mitigation plan in the post-incident report within 72 hours for Sev1.
- Evidence pointers: SOC2 report available under NDA; audit logs and retention details enumerated in the SOC2-Evidence-Index.pdf.

Attachments (attached to this message):
- Redwood_TAM_Coverage_Matrix.xlsx (updated with global overlap tab)
- Incident_Comm_Template.docx (customer update + internal playbook)
- SOC2-Evidence-Index.pdf (index & next-step to request SRN)

Operational contacts:
- Primary TAM: Chloe Martin — chloe_martin@redwood.ai
- Platform Reliability Lead: Laura Bennett — laura_bennett@redwood.ai
- Escalation/VP Coverage: Ben Carter — ben_carter@redwood.ai

If you’d like, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with our TAM + Reliability Lead to walk through the matrix before you present to your procurement committee. Available slots this week: Tue 11/3 10:00-11:00am ET or Wed 11/4 2:00-3:00pm ET.

Thanks again — looking forward to your feedback and happy to tighten any wording for contractual exhibits.

Best regards,
Chloe Martin
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
